messages:
emily.partners: Quick flag 1: upcoming SI cohort needs a concise onboarding toolkit: mentor handoff, voucher/reseller decision tree, and a light certification rubric. Can we build a 1-page kit + Google Sheet by next week?

sam_ops: +1. Recent cohorts wasted time on SKU mismatches and mentors not having a clear overlap workflow. One-pager sounds ideal.

greg_enable: I can own the mentor handoff + badge rubric. Thinking: 2 shadow sessions + 1 proctored practical (20m) to get a \"SI Mentor\" badge. Badge grants access to voucher pool.

yuki_market: I'll map voucher vs reseller flows and produce a tiny CSV: sku, local_offer, reseller_needed, tax_note. Will flag countries with known customs friction.

marta_legal: quick legal note: if vouchers trigger vendor invoices we need the sample vendor email and a template proforma for customs. I'll review templates but prefer the team drafts first.

si-ops-bot: Task created: ONB-9342 \"SI onboarding toolkit (1-pager + sheet)\" assigned to greg_enable, yuki_market, due 2024-12-05.

emily.partners: For mentor handoff: propose 30m overlap (10m quick sync + 20m co-support) and a shift log entry with: start/end, voucher codes verified, interop status, notes. Keep fields copy-pasteable.

greg_enable: sample shift log snippet I'll include: 

```
Shift date: 2024-12-12
Mentor: Greg Enable
Overlap: 30m
Voucher checked: CLAIM-XXXX (screenshot link)
Interop: PASS (nvidia-smi output attached)
Notes: swapped node 2, escalated ticket #ENG-412
```

yuki_market: For voucher/reseller parity, three flows: (A) marketplace token -> vendor redeems -> ship, (B) reseller portal -> manual accept -> vendor invoices for duties, (C) direct vendor invoice -> reimburse. I'll mark which SKUs follow which.

sam_ops: Can we add a gating rule: mentors must not start public cohorts until interop checkbox is ticked and voucher redemption confirmed? We lost hours spinning up labs when voucher failed.

marta_legal: sounds reasonable. Also add a short partner consent line when mentors gather redacted logs: \"Partner consents to share redacted logs for troubleshooting\". Keeps us covered.

greg_enable: Badge rubric: pass = 2 shadows + proctored practical. Practical tasks: run validation script, interpret two failure logs, escalate correctly. Pass/fail binary. Badge TTL 12 months. Renewal = 1 shadow + 1 short practical.

yuki_market: CSV will include tax_covered_by_voucher (yes/no) and reseller_accepts_token (true/false) columns. I'll add a sample vendor email template for reseller flows.

sam_ops: Validation script mentors ask partners to run. Keep it tiny and copyable. Example: 

```
#!/bin/bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv && 
uname -r && 
curl -fS https://assets.redwood/public/smoke-model.tar.gz -o /tmp/m.tar.gz
```

emily.partners: Also add a plain-language preflight for procurement teams who don't run scripts. Something like: "Please confirm GPU model, whether local tax applies, and if vendor accepts voucher token."

greg_enable: I'll draft the one-pager with sections: Quick checklist, Shift log, Voucher/reseller decision tree, Badge rubric, Escalation ladder. Keep it printable.

ymi_market: (typo fix) yuki_market: I'll also flag offers that are reseller-only so mentors know not to attempt marketplace redemption.

marta_legal: I'll circulate a short proforma invoice template and vendor email after you drop drafts. I'll also confirm allowed retention for redacted logs (default 90 days).

si-ops-bot: Reminder: draft review sync scheduled: 2024-12-06 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to owners.

sam_ops: Sheet design: columns cohort_id, mentor, shift_date, voucher_code, redemption_status, interop_validated (checkbox), reseller_flag, notes. Can we auto-append voucher redemptions from marketplace webhook?

yuki_market: Yes I can wire webhook to append redeemed vouchers (requires service account). For reseller/manual rows we'll add 'manual_redeem' tag.

greg_enable: For mentor handoff Slack snippet (copy/paste):

"Hi @team, handing off to @mentor_B. Overlap 30m. Voucher CLAIM-1234 verified. Interop: PASS. Escalations: tag @sam_ops."

emily.partners: Nice. One more: include an emergency fallback plan when hardware arrival delayed: (1) switch to dedicated hosted sandbox image, (2) reschedule final lab day, (3) notify sales. Keep steps short.

marta_legal: Also include a short clause: partners must confirm they hold any import permits required; we won't be liable for customs hold delays beyond vendor control. I'll draft wording.

si-ops-bot: Action items recorded: ONB-9342 owners and due dates.

ymi_market: (again typo) yuki_market: CSV ETA EOD Tue.

greg_enable: One-pager and badge rubric ETA EOD Tue. I'll post links here when ready.

sam_ops: I'll spin up the sheet and invite mentor leads + ops. Add a checkbox column "interop_validated" for mentors to tick after running script.

emily.partners: Great progress. Confirmed owners: greg_enable (one-pager + badge), yuki_market (CSV & webhook plan), sam_ops (sheet + ops). We'll review on 12/06. If no blockers I'll close thread after sync.

greg_enable: confirmed :thumbsup:

yuki_market: confirmed :thumbsup:

sam_ops: confirmed :thumbsup:

si-ops-bot: Meeting reminder: SI onboarding toolkit review 2024-12-06 15:00 UTC. End of thread."
